Write $h^{(\ge r)}A$ for the set of sums of $h$ elements of $A$, repetitions allowed, in which at least $r$ distinct elements occur. Then $|h^{(\ge r)}A| \ge h(k - 1) - r(r - 1) + 1$. nodes.summary: In the integers, the set of sums of three elements of $\{0, 1, 2\}$, repetitions allowed, in which at least two distinct elements occur is $3^{(\ge 2)}\{0, 1, 2\} = \{1, 2, 3, 4, 5\}$; the sums $0$ and $6$ need a single repeated term.
nodes.title: Example of a sumset with at least two distinct terms

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be an additive commutative monoid, $A$ a finite subset of $G$ and $h, r$ natural numbers. The sumset $h^{(\ge r)}A$ is the set of all sums of $h$ elements of $A$, repetitions allowed, in which at least $r$ distinct elements occur, that is, the elements $\sum_{a \in B} x_a a$ with $B \subseteq A$, $|B| \ge r$, positive integers $x_a$ and $\sum_{a \in B} x_a = h$.
nodes.title: Sums with at least $r$ distinct terms

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, $A$ a nonempty subset of $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ with $|A| = k$, and $h \ge 1$ a natural number. Then the $h$-fold sumset $hA = \{a_1 + \dots + a_h : a_1, \dots, a_h \in A\}$ satisfies $|hA| \ge \min(p,\ hk - h + 1)$.
nodes.title: Cauchy–Davenport theorem for $h$-fold sumsets

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, $A$ a nonempty subset of $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ with $|A| = k$, and $h$ a natural number with $1 \le h \le k$. Then the restricted sumset $h^{\wedge}A$ of sums of $h$ distinct elements of $A$ satisfies $|h^{\wedge}A| \ge \min(p,\ hk - h^2 + 1)$.
nodes.title: Dias da Silva–Hamidoune theorem

nodes.summary: Let $d$ and $t$ be natural numbers with $1 \le t \le d - 1$. Then every $\ell \in \mathbb{Z}/d\mathbb{Z}$ is the sum of the elements of some $t$-element subset $L \subseteq \mathbb{Z}/d\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Bajnok's lemma on subset sums in $\mathbb{Z}/d\mathbb{Z}$

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a finite set of integers with $|A| = k \ge 3$, $\min A = 0$ and $\gcd(A) = 1$, and let $b$ be a natural number. If $|2A| = 2k - 1 + b \le 3k - 4$, where $2A = \{a + a' : a, a' \in A\}$, then $A$ is contained in an arithmetic progression of length at most $k + b$.
nodes.title: Freiman's $3k - 4$ theorem

nodes.title: Lev's lower bound for iterated sumsets

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a finite set of integers with $k = |A| \ge 5$ elements and let $h$ be an integer with $2 \le h \le k - 2$. Write $h^{\wedge} A$ for the restricted sumset of $A$, the set of sums of $h$ distinct elements of $A$. If $|h^{\wedge} A| = hk - h^2 + 1$, then $A$ is an arithmetic progression of length $k$.

nodes.title: Plagne's theorem on the smallest iterated sumsets in cyclic groups

nodes.summary: In the integers, the restricted sumset $2^{\wedge}\{0, 1, 2\}$, the set of sums of two distinct elements of $\{0, 1, 2\}$, equals $\{1, 2, 3\}$.
nodes.title: Restricted twofold sumset of {0, 1, 2}

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, let $A$ be a subset of the cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ with $k = |A| \ge 2$ elements, let $h \ge 2$ be an integer, and let $hA = \{a_1 + \dots + a_h : a_1, \dots, a_h \in A\}$ be the $h$-fold sumset of $A$. If $|hA| = hk - h + 1$ and $hk - h + 1 \le p - 2$, then $A$ is an arithmetic progression of length $k$ in $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$.
